svg.title: Prompt chaining: the answer to one model call becomes text inside the next prompt
svg.desc: Two model calls side by side. Call one holds prompt 1, a model, and response 1. Its response names a category that does not exist, so your code's gate rejects it and sends it back to be re-asked with the rejection appended to the same prompt. The second answer passes the gate, and the validated category value then flies into an empty slot in prompt 2, which stays dimmed and unbuildable until it arrives. That splice, the previous answer becoming text inside the next prompt, is what the name prompt chaining refers to.
svg.text: The answer to call 1 becomes literal text inside the prompt for call 2. That splice is the chain.
